title: kith-tslocal: tests with mock Unix socket server
description:
Tests for WhoIs and Status clients using a mock HTTP-over-Unix-socket server.

What: Offline test suite covering valid parse, HTTP errors, socket not found. No real tailscaled needed.

Algorithm:
1. Create a mock Unix socket server in tests/integration_test.rs (or #[cfg(test)] mod):
   - Bind a tokio::net::UnixListener to a temp path (use tempfile::TempDir or std::env::temp_dir() + unique name)
   - Accept one connection, respond with canned HTTP/1.1 response (handcrafted bytes or hyper server)
   - Run listener in a tokio::spawn background task
2. Test cases (each spawns its own mock server on a unique socket path):

   Test A - whois valid parse:
   - Server returns: HTTP/1.1 200 OK + JSON body with known UserProfile
   - Assert: WhoIsResponse.user_profile.id == expected value (hardcoded from fixture)
   - Oracle: JSON fixture hand-constructed matching Tailscale spec

   Test B - whois HTTP 404:
   - Server returns: HTTP/1.1 404 Not Found
   - Assert: Err(AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_))

   Test C - socket not found:
   - Use a nonexistent socket path
   - Assert: Err(AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_)) - clean error, not panic

   Test D - status valid parse:
   - Server returns: HTTP/1.1 200 OK + JSON body with TailscaleIPs array
   - Assert: StatusResponse.tailscale_ips == expected vec

   Test E - status empty TailscaleIPs:
   - Server returns JSON with TailscaleIPs: []
   - Assert: Err(AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_)) - empty IPs rejected

   Test F - response too large (whois):
   - Server returns 200 OK + body > 100KB
   - Assert: Err(AuthError::WhoIsFailed(_)) - size limit enforced

3. JSON fixtures (hardcoded, not derived from code under test):
   WHOIS_JSON = '{"Node":{"Name":"mynode.tailnet.ts.net","Addresses":["100.64.0.1/32"]},"UserProfile":{"ID":"12345","LoginName":"alice@example.com","DisplayName":"Alice"},"CapMap":{}}'
   STATUS_JSON = '{"TailscaleIPs":["100.64.0.1","fd7a::1"],"BackendState":"Running"}'

Defensive rules:
- Each test must use a unique socket path (no shared state between tests)
- Tests must not require tailscaled to be running
- Never use code under test to generate expected values
- Clean up temp sockets after each test

Agent team: standard (R + I + T)
Oracle: JSON fixtures constructed from Tailscale LocalAPI spec, not from running the client code
